subject: AgileRPM Series A investment opportunity
text_body:
Hi investment team,

We are presenting AgileRPM, an enterprise SaaS platform for physical rehabilitation practice management.

We are raising a $12,000,000 USD Series A round and requesting $3,000,000 USD from your fund.

Please review the attached investment deck. We would be happy to answer your questions.

Best regards,
The AgileRPM demo team
